reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of soft ferromagnetism in prior FeCoNiPd/Pt alloys by proposing Mn substitution to introduce domain wall pinning via antiferromagnetic coupling and lattice strain, uses the correct baseline (FeCoNiPd/Pt), and provides a testable falsification rule. Hypothesis B incorrectly uses FeCoNi as baseline instead of the prior derivatives, proposes L10 ordering that is not established for this system, and cites irrelevant evidence about nanopowders.
